system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: All agents inOpsAgent are defined through an agent profile, a structured prompt template that specifies the agent’s name, task description, operational instructions, and illustrative examples.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only. Retrieved knowledge is injected per case (Sec. 3.4.2), so dynamically_composed is arguable. The quote may not match the PDF spacing exactly (the PDF text reads 'inOpsAgentare').

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: then queries its task-specific knowledge base via RAG, injecting the retrieved expe-riences into its prompt as auxiliary context
env_context_strategy.note: The data processor injects preprocessed observability descriptions (Sec. 3.2), and embedding RAG over a faiss knowledge base adds retrieved experience. Neither maps exactly onto an allowed value, so the closest value was chosen.

context_compaction.note: Paper only, with no config surface. Data filtering is input preprocessing, not history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: convert them into unified textual descriptions that serve as the input for the

tool_call_format.note: The paper describes no tool-call syntax. Agents produce CoT answers.

tool_count.note: No tool list is reported. The code repo was not in the evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: TheOrches-tratoraugments the originalQuerywith feedback indicating that the previous diagnosis was incorrect, then re-invokes the multi-agent collaboration until a diagnosis is confirmed by successful mitigation.
loop_primitives.note: The fixed pipeline runs intent, data processor, experts, cross-review, and report in sequence. Re-analysis happens after human-validated mitigation fails. The quote spacing follows the PDF extraction.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: reason over the same descriptions using Chain-of-Thought prompting

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: coordinating them with an orchestrator, and supporting iterative cross-review
multi_agent_topology.note: The system also includes peer cross-review among the three expert agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: theOrchestratorinitiates cross-review by bundling each answer and its rationale and dispatching it to the other two agents for peer review
delegation_mechanism.note: This is the closest value. The Orchestrator dispatches work to fixed role agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: In online deployment, engineers validate the report via mitigation actions.

short_term_state.note: The paper does not describe a state object.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The entries are embedded using a Sentence-Transformer [26] and stored in a faiss vector database.
long_term_memory.note: PPO fine-tuning also updates weights across runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: By requiring agents to critique others’ rationales, cross-review improves accuracy
self_verification.note: Peer critique among agents that share the same base model is the closest value. The LLM judge (Qwen3-235B) is used only for training reward.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: OpsAgentwas allowed to perform up to three rounds of re-analysis
retry_policy.note: Sec. 3.3.3 describes re-analysis until mitigation succeeds, and the deployment capped this at 3 rounds, so fixed_n is plausible. Retries are triggered by human feedback.

cost_controls.note: Cost efficiency comes from using a local 14B model, not from a harness mechanism.

execution_isolation.note: Agents do not execute actions. The Orchestrator retrieves data.

tracing.evidence_quote: All review mes-sages and refined rationales are recorded and included in theRoot Cause Report

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on OpenRCA, but the repo was not available to check for a built-in hook.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a lightweight, self-evolving multi-agent system for IM
target_domain.note: The domain is incident management / AIOps.

open_source.evidence_quote: All code, prompts and data are available in the repo
open_source.note: The repo is an anonymous mirror, and no licence was seen.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: For the seed LLMs, we restrict to models with at most 20B parameters and selectQwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M, gpt-oss-20b, andPhi-3-medium-128k-instruct.
model_agnostic.note: The quote follows the PDF extraction spacing.
